reviews.summary: SUI has a near-term protocol-upgrade event: mainnet v1.80.1 / Protocol 137 is scheduled for September 30, 2026, four days after this snapshot. It changes transaction validation and gas behavior; brief RPC interruptions are flagged by a major provider.
materialRisks: Near-term mainnet upgrade risk: v1.80.1 / Protocol 137 is scheduled for September 30, 2026; upgrade-day RPC interruptions and application or transaction-flow incompatibilities could affect execution and liquidity.

The release modifies transaction-expiration handling, transaction validation, JSON-RPC effects data, and gas behavior—changes that can create short-term operational risk for wallets, bots, RPC users, and apps.

facts.fact: Sui’s official GitHub release for mainnet-v1.80.1 was published September 23, 2026 and specifies Protocol Version 137, including changes to transaction expiration, validation, JSON-RPC effects data, and gas charging. ([github.com](https://github.com/MystenLabs/sui/releases?utm_source=openai))

QuickNode scheduled its Sui Mainnet upgrade to v1.80.1 for September 30, 2026 and warned that brief RPC availability interruptions may occur. This is provider-specific evidence, but indicates upgrade-related operational risk. ([quicknode.statuspage.io](https://quicknode.statuspage.io/?utm_source=openai))
Sui’s official status page reports all systems operational and no reported incidents from September 11 through September 25, 2026. ([status.sui.io](https://status.sui.io/?utm_source=openai))

The official SUI supply page confirms periodic future token releases, but the current search did not establish a dated, quantified release occurring within the next seven days. ([sui.io](https://www.sui.io/token-schedule?utm_source=openai))
